title: A decaying intermediate does not automatically reset conversion
statement: For introduced X=1-exp(-D), D=integral k I^m, 10,000 equal writes at background intensity fraction .02 and X_on=.95 need m>=3.810733802 for X_off<=.01 in this common-background model. Separately uprime=R-u/tau and Xprime=gamma*u/tau*(1-X), including complete final decay, give -log(1-X_final)=gamma*integral R. Lifetime changes timing rather than cumulative conversion. Thresholds, competing reactions, reversible products or restoration can change the equations.
